premise: Four-year-old Deniz, playing in COMMONS_COURTYARD, follows a faint repeating tap-tap sound to the rumored GARDEN_GATE and discovers, entirely on the courtyard side, that a low branch tapping the gate in the breeze is the source — without ever opening or crossing the gate.

beats.beat: While playing in COMMONS_COURTYARD, four-year-old Deniz hears a faint tap-tap-tap repeating from the direction of the rumored GARDEN_GATE and turns to listen.
He stands still and counts the taps on his fingers, noticing the sound comes in little bursts whenever a breeze stirs and pauses when the air goes still.
Curious, Deniz walks closer and stops a few steps from GARDEN_GATE, staying on the courtyard side without touching or opening it, and looks around for the sound's source.
He sees only the closed gate and nothing obviously moving at first; when the breeze dies the tapping stops, and when it returns the tapping starts again.
Following the rhythm, Deniz spots a thin low branch from a courtyard-side bush swaying in the breeze and tapping against the gate's edge.
He reaches out, holds the branch still, and the sound stops; he lets go, and the breeze taps it against the gate again.
Delighted, Deniz plays the game several times — holding the branch, letting go, holding it again — matching the tap-tap rhythm with his own hands.
He walks back into the open courtyard clapping the same tap-tap rhythm, while behind him the branch keeps tapping softly against the gate in the breeze.
